summary: A cream, centred single page told in colour-coded chapters (purple story, red roman, blue italic, green typewriter, pink family): every chapter heading is a looping morph animation between two labelled states (Thin–Bold, Condensed–Extended, Bland–GT Alpina, Proportional–Typewriter…) with a matching morphing emoji icon. Every paragraph on the page is editable and opens a pointer-driven axis overlay; the page ends with a long labelled specimen of Swiss-Alps copy.

instances.learn: Set each letter of the name in another subfamily (and let them morph) so the wordmark itself previews the seven subfamilies

instances.variantDefinition: The pointer's x and y position over the sample or the whole viewport (or device tilt on touch) each drive one variable axis, with edge tracks or labels showing the axis and its live value; no sliders to grab
instances.look: A hidden overlay (HTML only): an x-axis bar and a y-axis bar along the viewport edges, each labelled None/Size/Weight/Width/Contrast with a position dot, plus round buttons ✕, ▶, I, M, ↺ and 'Select Style ↑' opening a 7-column picker (Condensed, Standard, Extended, Fine Condensed, Fine Standard, Fine Extended, Typewriter × Thin–Bold Italic)
instances.ux: Focus a paragraph → overlay appears with that paragraph's default axes (data-default-axes, e.g. '2,1' = Width on x, Weight on y); moving the pointer sweeps the two axes; click an edge label to change its axis; I and M toggle italic and Typewriter; ▶ plays an automatic 'disco' sweep; ↺ resets; ✕ closes
instances.learn: Turn the whole viewport into a 2-axis pad for whatever text the visitor is reading: no sliders to find, and every paragraph is a tester

reconstruction.layout: Fixed overlay over the page: horizontal bar for the x axis and vertical bar for the y axis at the screen edges, each with a label and a dot; corner buttons; style picker panel ~1160×290px (7 lists of 11 items) anchored above the 'Select Style' button

reconstruction.behaviour: Pointer x/y → font-variation-settings of the focused .copy (axes indexed -1 none, 0 size, 1 weight, 2 width, 3 contrast); the edited paragraph keeps its new style; per-section data-axis-color tints the overlay
